test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the figure, O is the centre of the circle. Its two chords AB and CD intersect each other at the point P within the circle. If AB = 20 cm, PB = 12 cm and CP = 8 cm, then find the measure of PD.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56b59423ec92de5358648b763575b39c2c9895b182ca57c49af16e1ae251c7d1.png]
solution:
**Given:**

AB = 20 cm, PB = 12 cm and CP = 8 cm

**Concept used:**

If two chords intersect in a circle, then the products of the measures of the segments of the chords are equal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7f89f61d5f8fb43aa139ec7cd1936e0daf26c8704aea948ec5b5613fd298b85.png] 

AE × EC = DE × EB

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c543706fc6025b0ecf264fd838c366c30bb43e5e5665e41c3375cc88cb4f1be0.png] 

According to the concept,

AP × PB = CP × PD

⇒ (AB - PB) × 12 = 8 × PD

⇒ (20 - 12) × 12 = 8 × PD

⇒ 8× 12 = 8 × PD

⇒ PD = 12

**∴ The measure of PD is 12 cm.**
